answer: Proof of burn mitigates Sybil attacks by requiring agents to verifiably destroy base currency at unspendable addresses to activate credentials. Validating this sacrifice fortifies the operational timber of consensus against bots cloaked in sable anonymity. An attacker incurs the direct cost of extinguishing a financial ember per identity. However, wealthy adversaries can absorb these burns to amass disproportionate influence, pricing out smaller honest participants.
